text:
nina: FYI vault alerted on a small burst of unwraps for ciphertexts wrapped with projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/quiet-key between 01:03-01:07 UTC. principal shown in KMS logs: svc-sync@partner. suspicious since vendor onboarding didn't include that SA.
cal: paste admin audit snippet:
```
{"protoPayload": {"methodName":"google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy","principalEmail":"svc-sync@partner","resourceName":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/quiet-key","timestamp":"2026-04-10T01:02:58Z"}}
```
ryan: that SetIamPolicy would allow them to add bindings. do we have a Terraform or CI run that matches that timestamp?
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly score 0.92. Detected cross-project grant to vendor principal. Recommended: snapshot key IAM, export 30d audit, create ephemeral ops-SA for rewrap, revoke vendor binding, enumerate CMEK dependencies.
sec-oncall: containment plan: 1) snapshot metadata and usage 2) create ephemeral_sa@company with kms.rewrap rights 3) revoke vendor SA binding 4) rewrap any ciphertexts to new key 5) rotate Vault transit keys and any impacted service tokens. prefer canary flow.
vendor-sec: reached out to vendor. they say a config-sync ran but show no SetIamPolicy in their logs. asking for evidence.
nina: running asset search to list dependent resources:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:quiet-key" --format=json
```
cal: results: vault-transit-infra, backups-infra-2024, snapshots-db, analytics-export-bucket, worker-auth-fn.
ryan: check Vault audit to map which Vault paths used that key alias. we need list of secret paths to rotate.
nina: vault audit indicates transit mounts: auth/secrets, db/creds. uploading audit export: https://logs.internal/exports/quiet-key-443210.json :lock:
rotor-bot: incident INC-2026-118 created: quiet-key-unexpected-bind. Paging sec-oncall and SRE.
sec-oncall: creating ephemeral_sa and granting it only the exact permissions for rewrap (cryptoKeyVersions/useToEncrypt, decrypt for rewrap ops). will revoke after.
cal: performing staged revoke: grant ephemeral_sa to ops team, revoke svc-sync@partner binding at 4432101502, then run canary rewrap on analytics-export-bucket.
ryan: rewrap canary command:
```
./tools/rewrap --src quiet-key --dst quiet-key-rot-20260410 --resources ./quiet-key-canary.json --parallel 6
```
sec-oncall: revoke executed at 4432101502. monitoring for job failures.
nina: one backup job briefly failed and auto-restarted; no data loss. canary rewrap completed and smoke tests passed.
vendor-sec: vendor sent a follow-up showing their sync did an `iam_policy` apply with missing condition. we're updating onboarding checklist to require locked terraform and conditional bindings for cross-project access.
ryan: next steps: 1) finish full rewrap for remaining resources tomorrow morning in low-traffic window 2) rotate Vault transit keys and DB credentials by canaries 3) add alert rule for any SetIamPolicy on KMS keys from non-whitelisted projects 4) increase KMS audit retention to 90 days and export to secure archive.
sec-oncall: action items assigned: @nina collect 30d audit and map secret paths, @cal enumerate CMEK deps and schedule rewrap window, @ryan prepare token rotation playbook and smoke tests, @vendor-sec drive vendor onboarding changes. ops-SA will be revoked post-ops.
rotor-bot: [automated] retention change requested: KMS audit logs retention set to 90d for project prod.
nina: thanks all. keeping this thread as coordination point and for the postmortem notes. will write short blameless postmortem once rotations complete :thumbsup:
